title: Reverse-engineering NLI: A study of the meta-inferential properties of Natural Language Inference
text: the diamond is understood as existentially quantifying over accessible worlds. Table 1 shows the three different readings of each of the NLI relations. The first is based on the material conditional (MC) of classical propositional logic. The second corresponds to the strict conditional (SC) of Lewis and Langford ( 1959 ) . The third (EI) takes into account the fact that NLI premises are logically possible, giving the operator □ \Box existential import , similar to the universal premises of Aristotle’s syllogistics (Lewis and Langford, 1959 , p. 62ff) .
